decisions.rationale: Lupus erythematosus profundus is a subtype of lupus panniculitis, which is related to discoid lupus erythematosus

option_relations.rationale: Lupus erythematosus profundus is a subtype of lupus panniculitis, but the clinical presentation does not match the given vignette
Linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS) is a specific type of discoid lupus erythematosus with distinct clinical features
Discoid lupus erythematosus is the same disease entity as the one described in the leaf with ID B5.1
Lupus panniculitis (lupus profundus) is a broader term that encompasses discoid lupus erythematosus
